decisions.briefing: Markets were neutral today (NASDAQ -0.3%, S&P 500 -0.5%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash sits at $289.29, below the $500 deployment threshold, so per past lessons we're holding dry powder rather than forcing a buy — waiting for a genuine risk-on setup before deploying into the open slots.

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices drifted slightly lower today in quiet, directionless trading, with the S&P 500 underperforming the NASDAQ. There was no dominant catalyst driving the move — this looks like routine consolidation rather than a reaction to a specific event. Volume and volatility remained low, consistent with a wait-and-see posture among investors.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日兩大指數皆小幅回落，走勢缺乏方向，標普500表現略遜於納斯達克。市場並無明顯的單一觸發因素，較像是例行的整理走勢，而非對特定事件的反應。成交量與波動度維持在低檔，反映投資人普遍採取觀望態度。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" means keeping cash on hand instead of investing it immediately, so you have the flexibility to buy when a genuinely strong opportunity appears. On a neutral day with cash below the deployment threshold, it's often better to wait than to force a trade just to stay fully invested.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指保留現金而非立即全數投入市場，讓自己在真正出現強勢買點時仍有資金可以進場。在市況中性、現金又低於部署門檻的日子，與其為了「用滿資金」而勉強交易，不如耐心等待更明確的機會。
